narrative.overview:
Table d'Adrian is a private table set on warm ivory and near-black ink, with one champagne gold for the italic word, the hairline, and the photograph rim. Bodoni Moda carries the display line at a tight, engraved scale. Hanken Grotesk carries navigation, labels, and the sentence. A screen is a headline, a lede, a square booking control, and a plate.

The maison alternates two grounds. Ivory holds the about, services, menus, and wellness bands. Ink holds the first viewport, the plate gallery, the quotes, the closing invitation, and the footer. Structure is a 1px rule. Photographs are full-bleed crops. The hero plate, the about portrait, and the menu cover take a gold inset rim. The horizontal gallery does not.

Sola is the other room on the same domain. On `/sola`, the custom properties swap to cream and deep green, and both the sentence and the display line set in Source Serif 4. The houses do not share a metal or a typeface.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory grounds and near-black ink fields
One champagne gold, used as italic, rim, and hairline
Bodoni Moda for display, Hanken Grotesk for UI
A pinned split hero, a pinned service title, and a horizontal plate gallery
Sola as a cream and deep-green room in Source Serif 4

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Champagne is the only maison accent. It marks a word, a rim, a focus ring, or a hairline. If a surface is mostly gold, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Houses Rule
rules.body: Sola rewrites the token set to cream and deep green and sets type in Source Serif 4. Maison champagne and Bodoni stay off that room. Sola green stays off the maison.

rules.name: The Italic Word Rule
rules.body: A display line may set a single word in italic champagne. The rest stays roman, weight 500.

rules.name: The Grotesque Label Rule
rules.body: Labels, navigation, and buttons are Hanken Grotesk. Labels are uppercase and tracked. Display italics do not set a label.

rules.name: The Split Table Rule
rules.body: From 1024px the first viewport is a pinned two-column stage: the sentence on ink, the plate beside it. Below that breakpoint the plate stacks above the copy and the pin releases.

rules.name: The Still Page Rule
rules.body: When `prefers-reduced-motion` is set, durations collapse, the preloader does not render, the custom cursor does not, pins release, and the service list and the quotations stack in normal flow. The photograph and the booking control stay.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: A section is flat. Reach for ink, ivory, or a 1px rule before a shadow. Soft and lift are for the enquiry panel, the navigation menu, and the cookie bar.

rules.name: The Square Plate Rule
rules.body: The Button, the field, the nav book control, and the photograph frame are square. Do not round them to match a card library.

rules.name: The Inset Rim Rule
rules.body: A gold rim is an inset hairline on the hero plate, the about portrait, and the menu cover. It is not a frame around every image, and the horizontal gallery does not wear it.

dos: Do set maison display in Bodoni Moda, weight 500, tracking -0.03em (-0.035em on the hero), with at most one italic champagne word.
Do set navigation, labels, buttons, and the sentence in Hanken Grotesk.
Do keep maison grounds to warm ivory and near-black ink, and the accent to champagne.
Do separate rows with a 1px hairline, and inset a 1px champagne rim by 0.8rem on the hero plate, the about portrait, and the menu cover.
Do keep the booking control square: ivory on ink, or ink on ivory.
Do rewrite the token set and the typeface together on Sola: cream, deep green, Source Serif 4.
Do leave the photograph and the booking control in place when motion is reduced.
donts: Don't fill a maison button or a section with champagne.
Don't add a second metal or a saturated accent on the maison.
Don't set Sola in Bodoni, or the maison display in Source Serif 4.
Don't put Sola green on a maison surface.
Don't round the Button, the field, the nav book control, or the plate.
Don't use a hard offset shadow. Depth is the ink field, the hairline, and the soft or lift shadow on the enquiry panel, the navigation menu, and the cookie bar.
Don't replace a plate photograph with an illustration or a stock scene.
